pages.text: Add all flat bonuses or penalties to base capacity first. A Pouch adds 98 and a Bag adds 352. Equip one of each with a base of 500 and you have 950 capacity.

pages.title: Echo Rings
pages.text: Each $(l:biginventory:gear/echo_ring)Echo Ring$(/l) adds 50% of that same subtotal. At 950, one ring gives 1,425 and two give 1,900. Capacity rounds down to a whole number and has a minimum of zero.
